gaps.title: Outer Far-Field Momentum Linf Residual Norm Exceeds Acceptance Threshold

metrics.location: Outer far-field O-grid boundary cells (r = 8..10 m)

gaps.rootCause: Point-implicit Gauss-Seidel sweeps exhibit slow algebraic decay for low-frequency convective defects across large stretched outer boundary cells.
gaps.remediationPlan: Implement geometric multigrid cycling or far-field convective buffer damping to accelerate outer boundary flux relaxation.

gaps.title: Lift Coefficient Underprediction at 10 deg AoA Relative to NASA TMR LTPT Reference
gaps.rootCause: A combination of: (1) 1st-order upwind artificial viscosity smoothing the leading-edge suction peak (causally supported by +8.8% increase under central differencing); (2) coarse leading-edge circumferential resolution (4-8 cells across nose curvature); (3) log-law wall function approximation rather than low-Re viscous sublayer resolution (y+ < 0.2); and (4) absence of vortex circulation correction on the circular far-field boundary at R = 10c.
gaps.remediationPlan: Generate high-resolution C-grid or clustered O-grid (Delta x/c <= 0.0005 at nose, y+ < 0.5), implement point-vortex far-field circulation correction, and resolve turbulent boundary layer directly.

gaps.title: Turbulence Model PDE Transport Residual Decoupling
gaps.rootCause: SST k-omega evaluates eddy viscosity limiter algebraically but does not iteratively solve coupled transport PDEs for k and omega updates during outer iterations.
gaps.remediationPlan: Implement fully coupled implicit matrix solver for k and omega transport equations.
